checked_not_listed.name: Barnes & Noble
checked_not_listed.reason: A firsthand search at build time found no Sonny Angel product listing on its store. Not recommended until a real listing is verified.

checked_not_listed.name: Unvetted marketplace shops and social media sellers
checked_not_listed.reason: The official USA store warns that fake websites copy its product photos and descriptions. Any shop that cannot be tied to a real retailer record stays off this list.

retailers.kind: Official online store, Dreams USA, Inc.
retailers.name: Sonny Angel USA, official store
retailers.verification: Fetched firsthand at build time. The store agreement page names Dreams USA, Inc. and a Providence, Rhode Island address. Its own news post lists sonnyangelusa.com as the one official USA and Canada site, and points to the app Store tab for the authorized retailer list.
retailers.watch_for: Every new series lands here first, with member points and restock notices.

retailers.kind: Bookstore chain webstore and US stores
retailers.name: Books Kinokuniya USA
retailers.verification: Catalog fetched firsthand at build time with live prices and Dreams USA product codes, including Animal Ver. 1 at code 4542202653753 and the Pumpkin Patch Series at 4542202659885. Real stock history across regular, HIPPERS and limited lines.
retailers.watch_for: Regular series, HIPPERS and seasonal limiteds. Member pricing runs about ten percent under list. Per person limits are posted per product, a sign of real allocation.

retailers.kind: National retailer, online and in store
retailers.name: Urban Outfitters
retailers.verification: Product pages fetched firsthand at build time with style numbers, including the HIPPERS page carrying the local store supply note. Real Sonny Angel stock history across at least six series.
retailers.watch_for: HIPPERS, Looking Back, Snack, Fruit, Animal Ver. 1 and the Vacation Series. Its product page tells shoppers to check local stores for a limited supply, so store stock often moves before online stock.

retailers.kind: Independent toy and gift shop, Ninth Street, New York
retailers.name: an.me, New York
retailers.verification: Store search fetched firsthand at build time showing 58 Sonny Angel products at near list prices, including Animal Ver. 1 to 4, Flower, Vegetable and HIPPERS Harvest. The shop carries press coverage of its January 2024 Sonny Angel drop crowd.
retailers.watch_for: A deep back catalog, 58 Sonny Angel results at build time, including older regular series that larger stores no longer list. In person drops draw lines, so online restocks go fast.

rule: A shop joins this list only after a firsthand check at the date shown: a real retailer, a real Sonny Angel catalog with prices in the normal range, and a stock history across more than one series. Listings are rechecked by rotation. The official USA app Store tab is the authority for authorized retailers.
